_comment: Pinned fallback for lib/base/rules.mjs when the Central Context hub is not configured or not reachable. Refresh from a running hub: GET /v1/manifest for release_id, GET /v1/documents/<id> for each rule in GATE_RULES.

rules.title: Ready requirement before test generation
rules.summary: A test is derived from a requirement only when the requirement states the expected outcome in checkable terms, in its acceptance criteria or in the Xray test case linked to it, and every expected value in the test is stated by the requirement or follows from its rule.

rules.title: Fail evidence for generated tests
rules.summary: A test derived from a requirement enters the suite only with recorded evidence that it fails when the behaviour it checks is broken: a failing run on the code before a bug fix, or a run in which the test kills a mutant of the code under test. Coverage is not that evidence.

rules.title: Every test asserts an observable outcome
rules.summary: Every test asserts at least one observable outcome of the code under test: a returned value, a stored state, an error, a displayed text, or an outbound call together with its arguments.

rules.title: Justified changes to existing tests
rules.summary: A change that loosens an assertion, removes a test or skips one carries, in the same merge request, the requirement change or the ticket that justifies it; a red suite otherwise turns green by a change to the code under test.
